label: D1 after a rewarded rare a2->S1 trial when the agent will stay with a2 (episode trials < 70)
explanation: Fires only at D1, and only when the reward input is 1. It fires when the previous trial was a2 that went rarely to S1 and was rewarded (the case where a model-based agent should switch), but only when the agent is about to choose a2 again, i.e. a model-free-like stay. On the same history it is silent when the agent switches to a1, and that is most of the remaining false positives. It also never fires after episode trial ~70: activity falls off in trials 60-69 and is zero from 70 on, which suggests a slow drift in the hidden state. The action term is the agent own upcoming choice, which it computes, so it is allowed. ep_trial is not an input but is not a future variable either. No future reward or transition is used. Without the action term, F1 is 0.75 (precision 0.65). The window-first-trial D1 steps (rel -3, previous trial unseen) make up about 10% of missed mass. Silent at GO and D2, after a1 trials, after common transitions, and after no reward. Magnitude varies (median 0.53 of max), and I did not check what drives it.

issues: Claims check out on the dev profile and the test split. The feature is active only at D1 (GO 0, D2 0). Its mass is 1.000 on in_rew==1, with only 40 activations after in_rew==0. After prev_action==1 there are 7 activations and after prev_common==1 there are 7. With action==2 at D1 it has 98% of the mass. On D1 with ep_trial>=70, 1 of 121440 steps is active.
The same history followed by a switch to a1 is mostly silent (precision 0.08 on 5342 steps), as claimed.

Most of the remaining false positives are graded rather than a separate class. In ep_trial 60-69, precision is 0.48 on 1336 predicted steps, about 700 of the 1437 test false positives. This matches the stated fall-off. Precision is also lower when the trial two back was unrewarded (0.69 vs 0.90) and when good==S1 (0.77 vs 0.90). These read as magnitude modulation, not a missing condition: adding them only nudges F1 (0.850 for ep_trial<70 with the two-back-unrewarded cases excluded from ep_trial 50 on; 0.858 for ep_trial<65).

Misses: about 9% of the activation mass is D1 on the window's first trial (rel -3), where prev_* is undefined. This is a window artifact and is acknowledged. Misses inside the window hold only 2.2% of the mass, so they are scattered noise.
Test scores reproduce: precision 0.837, recall 0.854, F1 0.846, mass recall 0.888. No future variables are used. The action term is the agent's own upcoming choice.
